verdict.rationale: Snowflake's RBAC model lets access privileges be scoped to roles that can be assigned narrowly (snowflake-docs-8/32/45), and the CLI/MCP server require credentials at execution time (snowflake-probe-rt-2, snowflake-docs-14/57), implying an agent could be given a limited-privilege role/key. However there is no explicit documentation of an API-credential/token issuance workflow (e.g., scoped PATs, OAuth scopes) purpose-built for AI agents — missing for 10: dedicated agent credential/token scoping docs, explicit least-privilege agent onboarding guide, and independent confirmation this is used in practice for agent credentialing.
